nodes.natural_language: x and y are distinct nonzero reals satisfying x + 2/x = y + 2/y
nodes.statement:
x,y \in \mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}, x
eq y, x+2/x=y+2/y

nodes.natural_language: multiply both sides by xy to clear denominators
nodes.statement: xy(x+2/x)=xy(y+2/y) implies x^2 y + 2y = x y^2 + 2x

nodes.natural_language: rearrange terms to factor
nodes.statement: x^2 y - x y^2 + 2y - 2x =0 implies xy(x-y)-2(x-y)=0

nodes.natural_language: from either factorization conclude xy=2
nodes.statement:
(x-y)(xy-2)=0 or (x-y)(1-2/(xy))=0 with x
eq y imply xy=2

nodes.natural_language: Rearrange the given equation as \(x-y+2(1/x-1/y)=0\) and factor
combine the cleared equation with the factored form (x-y)(1-2/(xy))=0
nodes.statement: from l1 and l4: xy(x-y)=2(x-y) together with (x-y)(1-2/(xy))=0 imply xy=2

nodes.natural_language: Multiply both sides of the given equation by \(xy\) to obtain \(x^2 y + 2y = xy^2 + 2x\)
nodes.statement: xy(x + 2/x) = xy(y + 2/y) implies x^2 y + 2 y = x y^2 + 2 x

nodes.natural_language: Rearrange the given equation as \(x-y=2/y-2/x\) and factor the right-hand side
nodes.statement: x-y=2(x-y)/(xy) implies (x-y)(1-2/(xy))=0

nodes.natural_language: from the factored form conclude xy=2
nodes.statement:
(x-y)(1-2/(xy))=0 with x
eq y imply xy=2

nodes.natural_language: both independent factorizations establish xy=2, hence the product equals 2
nodes.statement: xy=2
